svg.text: Fit the dual Acme lift on the drum centerline
Both nuts sit under the cut. The table rises in Z without racking in X or Y.
Rev B geometry · fab B.4 · inches
Confirm flange BCD before drilling · FABRICATION REVIEW
Grey = already built · colour = this step
Screw both P-018 thrust blocks to the base at Y 11″ (drum CL), X left and right. Fit
Bolt a bronze nut block under the table, each nut on the same Y as its screw — not
at the infeed and outfeed ends.
Fit both ½-10 Acme screws. One turn is 0.1000″. Thirty turns is 3″ (CALC-003).
Chain-couple the two screws. Fit the left clutch and P-019 home dog (J-014).
Run the table through the full 3.25″ of travel. Shoes must stay wrapped; the table
PARTS TRAY — fetch these before you start
TOOLS: Wrenches · Drill · Tape measure · Square
OPEN THESE SHEETS: P-016 · P-018 · P-019 · A-03 · M-101
Table rises and falls freely through full travel; both ends
move the same amount; shoes stay captured.
